caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden table with a reddish-brown hue, featuring a simple top surface and decorative scalloped apron along the lower edges of its frame. The table stands on four long, thin, curved cabriole legs. The legs have a gradient effect, transitioning from the reddish-brown of the table’s body at the top to a lighter yellowish color toward the bottom, as if they are melting or dripping. The table has two front panels resembling drawer fronts, outlined in a lighter shade, but no visible handles. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or embellishments present.
title: Rectangular Serving Table
